articles.title: Ex-Lakers player speaks out in defense of Enes Kanter, doubles down against WNBA's trans issue - Fox News
articles.description: Matt Ryan backed Enes Kanter Freedom's ejection from the Indiana Fever-Chicago Sky game, calling out the WNBA's failure to protect women's sports.
articles.content:
Ex-Los Angeles Lakers forward Matt Ryan isn't staying quiet after watching Enes Kanter Freedom get escorted out of Wintrust Arena on Sunday night for standing up for female athletes.
